tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Novaterra Health** is a hospital network that runs clinical and administrative workloads across Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and an on-premises data center.

**Current Environment:**
- Azure hosts patient-portal web apps, Azure SQL databases, and about 120 VMs across two subscriptions.
- AWS hosts a legacy claims-processing system on EC2 instances.
- The on-premises data center contains Windows Server domain controllers and a fleet of Linux syslog-emitting network appliances (firewalls and load balancers) that support Common Event Format (CEF).
- The security operations team currently reviews alerts in separate consoles for each environment and has no centralized SIEM.

tabs.title: Security Requirements
tabs.content:
The security operations director has defined the following requirements:

**Posture Management:**
- A single view of security recommendations and secure score must cover Azure and AWS resources.
- Compliance against HIPAA/HITRUST and Microsoft cloud security benchmark standards must be assessed continuously.
- Servers in AWS and on-premises must receive the same vulnerability scanning and endpoint protection recommendations as Azure VMs.

**Security Operations:**
- All security telemetry must be centralized in Microsoft Sentinel: Azure activity and resource logs, Windows Security events from domain controllers, and CEF messages from the network appliances.
- High-severity incidents involving confirmed credential compromise must automatically disable the affected user account and post a notification to the on-call channel.
- The SOC analysts must be able to manage incidents without being able to change analytics rules or connectors.
